reviews.headline: Quiet Excellence, Truly Felt
reviews.sentence: Real reviews from travelers who made Dosha Hotel their home in Adama.

item1.text: The calmest and most elegant stay in Adama. Spotless rooms, welcoming staff, and delicious dining.

item2.text: The terrace at dusk is breathtaking. Great hot water, fast Wi-Fi, and very peaceful nights.

item3.text: Outstanding service and location. Perfect stopover between Addis and Hawassa.

item4.text: The reception team went above and beyond. The bar drinks and food exceeded all expectations.

item5.text: Clean, modern, and very comfortable beds. Will definitely be returning every time I visit Nazret.

item6.text: A genuine gem in Adama. Quiet luxury without any unnecessary noise or hassle.

location.headline: Conveniently Situated in Adama (Nazret)
location.sentence: Located along the Wonji Mazoria to Adama Steel Factory road, directly in front of Dembela Secondary School.
